summary: Operator site: 25 full-hookup 50x30 ft lots (20/30/50 A), WiFi, no restrooms or showers, open year-round; motorhome rate $50 a night (tax and card fee included; $40 is for 30 A bumper-pull trailers), weekly/monthly too; reserve by request form or phone; 2000+ model-year rule (EKKO 2023 passes). 'No water on site' resolved: it was the rules' 'No restroom or shower facilities' - water hookups are at every lot. Google 4.6 stars / 27 reviews, phone (877) 478-7275 matches. At the $50 line, not over it (no gateway within 40 km; no family stays).
